faq.q: What's the difference between ready-made and custom?
faq.a: Ready-made solutions are proven agents or workflows we configure for your business — faster to launch. Custom agents are designed and built from scratch around your specific process.

faq.q: Can I request an AI agent that isn't listed?
faq.a: Yes. The examples are not limits. Describe what you need and we'll tell you honestly whether it's feasible and how we'd build it.

faq.q: Which tools can it connect to?
faq.a: It depends on the tools you use and whether they offer integrations. We confirm compatibility during scoping — we don't promise it upfront.

Every solution gets a custom quote. Some have a one-time setup cost, some also have ongoing costs for hosting, AI usage, messaging or support. Third-party costs are paid by you directly and listed in the proposal before you commit. Ready-made solutions with a confirmed price are shared on request.
